title: CompatibilityRequest
description: The union of inventory and shopping-cart items to validate. Stateless: the same request always yields the same verdict.

Channel.description: Sales channel of the transaction. Request-level, not per item. Rules carrying a channel apply only when it matches.

Items.description: Every promotion and add-on offering under consideration, from inventory and cart alike.

itemId.description: Unique within the request. Referenced by ItemIncompatibility and Exceptions rules.

itemType.description: An add-on is just an item, so every rule works on both.

discountCategory.description: Must exist in the CategoryPrecedence table; unknown categories rank last.

origin.description: Which side the item came from. Defaults to CART. Inventory items win ties.

scopeId.description: The contract/subscription the item applies to. Conflicts are evaluated within a scope, never across scopes. Omitted means one implicit shared scope.

serviceType.description: Enables per-service-type rules. A rule with a blank serviceType is global.
